agent_explanation: Energy explosion at step 31 when fast light body (initial 58 m/s) hits heavy body (m 19.3kg, e=0) resting on floor. Heavy body jumps from ~7.5 m/s to ~38.4 m/s while light body still ~22 m/s, injecting ~12kJ. Likely cause: simultaneous inelastic floor contact + elastic body-body with large mass ratio and high dt (0.0245s) leads to compounding positional correction / restitution impulses creating non-physical kinetic energy.
